cold: #197's cold test: written before the pose, from the sources alone. Don't read it while posing this lift, and tune neither to the other.
sources: exercises.json: round your back as you crunch
docs/research/grip.md: a rope, mid-palm, the fist just above the end stop

lines.says: the trunk folds from near upright to well forward
the hips stay about over the knees: the trunk folds, the hips don't sit back
the arms stay bent, the hands by the head
the arms hold their angle: the abs pull, not the arms
the back rounds, the spine curling over, rather than a flat back hinging at the hips
the hands hold the rope beside the head and travel with it
the lifter kneels facing the tower, the rope down from a high pulley
